patches.reason: Keep IRQs enabled during compression; retain the balanced PHP/PLP.
patches.contract: Only I differs between PHP at +0419 and PLP at +0965. All other registers, memory and stack effects are unchanged.

patches.reason: Observe owning Process BREAK after every completed 64-byte compression block.
patches.contract: JSR to the native checkpoint preserves all registers/status and returns to the next-block loop. It replaces the private OS BREAK-byte poll; A/N/Z from that poll are dead before use. The cleanup trap receives SDX 128 only after native I/O settles.

patches.reason: Reuse the verification EOF tail as PLP/BRA retry, balancing PHP on invalid hex.
patches.contract: Invalid-hex paths enter with one saved P byte. Pop it and branch to the next-record loop at +013E. Normal EOF now returns at +0135; the existing final FCLOSEAL closes the checksum handle.

patches.reason: Return through the existing RTS; final FCLOSEAL owns checksum-file closure.
patches.contract: BMI targets +0135 instead of +0136. The caller removes its error trap and closes all files before U_FAIL 0.

patches.reason: Route invalid high hex nibble through the balanced retry.
patches.contract: Only the taken branch changes, to +0136. Valid digest parsing is identical.

patches.reason: Route invalid low hex nibble through the balanced retry.
patches.contract: Only the taken branch changes, to +0136, exactly -128 bytes from the following PC.

unsupported: Other drives, writes, seeks, overlays and general hardware access
